sentences.en: TUTOR: OK, Jim.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的，吉姆。

sentences.en: You wanted to see me about your textile design project.
sentences.zh: 你找我是为了你的纺织品设计项目。

sentences.en: JIM: That's right.
sentences.zh: JIM: 没错。

sentences.en: I've been looking at how a range of natural dyes can be used to colour fabrics like cotton and wool.
sentences.zh: 我一直在研究一系列天然染料如何用于给棉、羊毛等织物染色。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Why did you choose that topic?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 你为什么选择这个主题？

sentences.en: JIM: Well, I got a lot of useful ideas from the museum, you know, at that exhibition of textiles.
sentences.zh: JIM: 嗯，我在博物馆——就是那场纺织品展览中——获得了很多有用的想法。

sentences.en: But I've always been interested in anything to do with colour.
sentences.zh: 但我一直对任何与色彩相关的事物都很感兴趣。

sentences.en: Years ago, L went to a carpet shop with my parents when we were on holiday in Turkey, an remember all the amazing colours.
sentences.zh: 多年前，我和父母在土耳其度假时曾去过一家地毯店，至今还记得那些令人惊叹的色彩。

sentences.en: TUTOR: They might not all have been natural dyes.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 那些色彩未必全都是用天然染料染成的。

sentences.en: JIM: Maybe not, but for the project I decided to follow it up.
sentences.zh: JIM: 或许不是，但为了这个项目，我决定就此深入探究。

sentences.en: And found a great book about a botanic garden in California that specialises in plants used for dyes.
sentences.zh: 我还发现了一本关于加利福尼亚州一座植物园的优秀书籍，该植物园专门种植用于染色的植物。

sentences.en: TUTOR: OK.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的。

sentences.en: So, in your project, you had to include a practical investigation.
sentences.zh: 所以，在你的项目中，你必须包含一项实践性调查。

sentences.en: JIM: Yeah.
sentences.zh: JIM: 是的。

sentences.en: At first I couldn't decide on my variables. ! was going to just look at one type of fibre for example, like cotton
sentences.zh: 起初我无法确定自己的变量。我原本打算只研究一种纤维类型，比如棉。

sentences.en: TUTOR: and see how different types of dyes affected it?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 然后观察不同类型的染料对其产生的影响？

sentences.en: JIM: Yes.
sentences.zh: JIM: 对。

sentences.en: Then I decided to include others as well, so I looked at cotton and wool and nylon.
sentences.zh: 后来我决定也纳入其他纤维类型，因此我考察了棉、羊毛和尼龙。

sentences.en: TUTOR: With just one type of dye?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 只使用一种染料？

sentences.en: JIM: Various types, including some that weren't natural, for comparison.
sentences.zh: JIM: 不是，我使用了多种染料，包括一些非天然染料，以便进行对比。

sentences.en: TUTOR: OK.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的。

sentences.en: JIM: So, I did the experiments last week.
sentences.zh: JIM: 因此，我上周做了实验。

sentences.en: I used some ready-made natural dyes, I found a website which supplied them, they came in just a few days, but I also made some of my own.
sentences.zh: 我使用了一些现成的天然染料——我在一个网站上找到了供应商，几天内就寄到了；此外，我也自己制作了一些染料。

sentences.en: TUTOR: That must have taken quite a bit of time.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 这一定花费了不少时间。

sentences.en: JIM: Yes, I'd thought it'd just be a matter of a teaspoon or so of dye, and actually that wasn't the case at all.
sentences.zh: JIM: 是的，我原以为只需一茶匙左右的染料即可，结果完全不是这么回事。

sentences.en: Like I was using one vegetable, beetroot, for a red dye, and I had to chop up a whole pile of it.
sentences.zh: 比如，我用甜菜根这种蔬菜制作红色染料，不得不切碎一大堆甜菜根。

sentences.en: So it all took longer than I'd expected.
sentences.zh: 因此整个过程比我预想的耗时更长。

sentences.en: TUTOR: One possibility is to use food colourings.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 一种可行的选择是使用食用色素。

sentences.en: JIM: I did use one.
sentences.zh: JIM: 我确实用了一种。

sentences.en: That was a yellow dye, an artificial one.
sentences.zh: 那是一种黄色的人工染料。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Tartrazine?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是酒石黄吗？

sentences.en: JIM: Yeah.
sentences.zh: JIM: 没错。

sentences.en: I used it on cotton first.
sentences.zh: 我首先将其用于棉布。

sentences.en: It came out a great colour, but when I rinsed the material, the colour just washed away.
sentences.zh: 染出来的颜色非常漂亮，但当我冲洗布料时，颜色却完全被洗掉了。

sentences.en: I'd been going to try it out on nylon, but l abandoned that idea.
sentences.zh: 我原本打算再试试尼龙，但后来放弃了这个想法。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Were you worried about health issues?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 你担心健康问题吗？

sentences.en: JIM: I'd thought if it's a legal food colouring, it must be safe.
sentences.zh: JIM: 我当时想，既然是合法的食用色素，那应该就是安全的。

sentences.en: TUTOR: it Well, it can occasionally cause allergic reactions, I believe.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 嗯，据我所知，它偶尔可能引发过敏反应。

sentences.en: TUTOR: So what natural dyes did you look at?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 那么，你研究了哪些天然染料？

sentences.en: JIM: Well. one was turmeric.
sentences.zh: JIM: 嗯，其中一种是姜黄。

sentences.en: The colour's great, it's a really strong yellow.
sentences.zh: 颜色很棒，是一种非常鲜艳的黄色。

sentences.en: It's generally used in dishes like curry.
sentences.zh: 它通常用于咖喱等菜肴中。

sentences.en: TUTOR: It's meant to be quite good for your health when eaten, but you might find it's not permanent when it's used as a dye - a few washes, and it's gone.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 据说食用对健康很有益，但若用作染料，其色牢度却不高——洗几次就褪色了。

sentences.en: JIM: Right.
sentences.zh: JIM: 好的。

sentences.en: I used beetroot as a dye for wool.
sentences.zh: 我曾用甜菜根为羊毛染色。

sentences.en: When I chop up beetroot to eat I always end up with bright red hands, but the wool ended up just a sort of watery cream shade.
sentences.zh: 平时切甜菜根吃的时候，我的手总会变成鲜红色；但染出来的羊毛却只呈现出一种淡而稀薄的乳白色。

sentences.en: Disappointing.
sentences.zh: 令人失望。

sentences.en: TUTOR: There's a natural a dye called Tyrian purple.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 还有一种名为泰尔紫的天然染料。

sentences.en: Have you heard of that?
sentences.zh: 你听说过吗？

sentences.en: JIM: Yes.
sentences.zh: JIM: 听说过。

sentences.en: It comes from a shellfish, and it was worn in ancient times but only by important people as it was so rare.
sentences.zh: 它源自一种贝类，古时仅由重要人物穿着，因其极为稀有。

sentences.en: I didn't use it.
sentences.zh: 我没用过它。

sentences.en: TUTOR: It fell out of use centuries ago, though one researcher managed to get hold of some recently.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 这种染料几个世纪前就已不再使用，不过最近有一位研究人员成功获得了少量。

sentences.en: But that shade of purple can be produced by chemical dyes nowadays.
sentences.zh: 但如今这种紫色已可通过化学染料轻松获得。

sentences.en: Did you use any black dyes?
sentences.zh: 你用过黑色染料吗？

sentences.en: JIM: Logwood.
sentences.zh: JIM: 用了苏木。

sentences.en: That was quite complicated. had to prepare the fabric so the dye would take.
sentences.zh: 这过程相当复杂，我得先对织物进行预处理，才能让染料上色。

sentences.en: TUTOR: I hope you were careful to wear gloves.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 我希望你当时小心地戴了手套。

sentences.en: JIM: Yes. know the danger with that dye.
sentences.zh: JIM: 是的，我知道这种染料的危险性。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Good.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 很好。

sentences.en: It can be extremely dangerous if it's ingested.
sentences.zh: 如果误食，它可能极其危险。

sentences.en: Now, presumably you had a look at an insect-based dye?
sentences.zh: 那么，你大概也查阅过昆虫类染料吧？

sentences.en: Like cochineal, for example?
sentences.zh: 比如胭脂虫红？

sentences.en: JIM: Yes. didn't actually make that, I didn't have time to start crushing up insects to get the red colour and anyway they're not available here, but managed to get the dye quite easily from a website.
sentences.zh: JIM: 是的。我其实并未亲手制作——没时间去碾碎昆虫提取红色色素，况且本地也买不到这类昆虫；不过我很容易就从一个网站上购得了成品染料。

sentences.en: But it cost a fortune.
sentences.zh: 但价格贵得离谱。

sentences.en: I can see why it's generally just used in cooking, and in small quantities.
sentences.zh: 我能理解它为何通常仅用于烹饪，且用量极少。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes, it's very effective, but that's precisely why it's not used a as a dye.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 没错，它效果极佳，但也正因如此，才不常被用作染料。

sentences.en: JIM: I also read about using metal oxide.
sentences.zh: JIM: 我还读到过利用金属氧化物染色的方法。

sentences.en: Apparently you can allow iron to rust while it's in contact with the fabric, and that colours it.
sentences.zh: 据说可将铁置于织物上任其生锈，从而给织物着色。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes, that works well for dying cotton.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的，这种方法对棉布染色效果很好。

sentences.en: But you have to be careful as the metal can actually affect the fabric and so you can't expect to get a lot of wear out of fabrics treated in this way.
sentences.zh: 但你必须小心，因为金属实际上会损伤织物，因此经此法处理的织物耐用性较差。

sentences.en: And the colours are quite subtle, not everyone likes them.
sentences.zh: 而且所染出的颜色较为柔和，未必人人都喜欢。

sentences.en: Anyway, it looks as if you've done a lot of work
sentences.zh: 总之，看来你做了大量工作。
